## Ravenfield VR (next, after 1.16.12)

- Started from Steam with SteamVR closed, Ravenfield no longer comes up flat on the Oculus desktop: it starts SteamVR itself and goes into VR as soon as SteamVR and the headset are ready (up to two minutes), with a notice on the screen while it waits. The launcher waits as long.
